card.name: Start of antihypertensive/anticholinergic after 'the'
card.fires_on: The first piece 'ant' of antihypertensive or anticholinergic after 'diminish the' or 'intensify the' in drug-interaction text. Also weaker on words like serotonin or calcium that lead into 'reuptake' or 'channel blockers'.

modes.label: ant- before -ihypertensive
modes.description: The 'ant' beginning antihypertensive or anticholinergic after a verb like diminish, counteract or intensify plus 'the'.
modes.example: Concomitant use with naproxen tablets or naproxen sodium tablets may diminish the<< ant>>ihypertensive effect of these drugs

modes.label: Drug-class lead-in word
modes.description: A word that names a mechanism and is followed by a class noun, such as serotonin before reuptake or calcium before channel blockers.
modes.example: nifedipine, verapamil ↑<< calcium>> channel blockers Clinical monitoring of patients is recommended

card.plain: It fires on the opening of 'antihypertensive' or 'anticholinergic' in interaction warnings about one drug weakening or boosting another's effect.
